measurements.name: vth_up
measurements.spice: .meas tran vth_up find v(vin) when v(sout)=v(vmid) fall=1

measurements.name: vth_dn
measurements.spice: .meas tran vth_dn find v(vin) when v(sout)=v(vmid) rise=1

measurements.name: i_peak_rise
measurements.spice: .meas tran i_peak_rise max par('abs(i(Vdd))') from=0 to=2u

measurements.name: t_peak_rise
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_peak_rise max_at par('abs(i(Vdd))') from=0 to=2u

measurements.name: i_peak_fall
measurements.spice: .meas tran i_peak_fall max par('abs(i(Vdd))') from=2u to=4u

measurements.name: t_peak_fall
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_peak_fall max_at par('abs(i(Vdd))') from=2u to=4u

measurements.name: i_vdd2_rise
measurements.spice: .meas tran i_vdd2_rise find par('abs(i(Vdd))') when v(vin)=v(vmid) rise=1

measurements.name: i_vdd2_fall
measurements.spice: .meas tran i_vdd2_fall find par('abs(i(Vdd))') when v(vin)=v(vmid) fall=1
